title: Row and column shadows
notes: On another visit, K-1 can design unique and ambiguous shadow puzzles (P5-6), keeping a dot record before reusing counters. Grades 2-3 can choose a shortest switch route (P4) or partner puzzle-making (P5). Grades 4-5 can return to the fixed full/empty-column case (P4) and the general two-row distance rule (P5), or finish the concrete shortest route (P3). Save both endpoint pictures; the current counter allowance supports comparison, not preserving a whole catalog in objects.
